name: loadingoverlay
need: Block one region while work on it runs, with a spinner and a message, and keep the rest of the page usable

--ds-loadingoverlay-veil.description: loading overlay: the veil over the region's content (`.ds-loadingoverlay--opaque`: the plain surface)

--ds-loadingoverlay-radius.description: loading overlay: the box's radius at the default shape

--ds-loadingoverlay-padding.description: loading overlay: the box's padding at the comfortable density

--ds-loadingoverlay-spinner-size.description: loading overlay: the spinner in the box at md (`--ds-spinner-size` there)

labExempt.DS.loadingoverlay.create: events only: the overlay's fade is shown in the entry loadingoverlay-show
